answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run random probe audits: each identity periodically gets a paid micro-task whose solution requires live, verifiable compute and a fresh signed artifact. Fail or skip a probe and the stake backing your identity is slashed nonlinearly, so an attacker minting N clones must post N stakes and keep N machines answering probes, turning cheap fake identities into a costly atlas of infrastructure — like keeping every yarrow stem in a garden fed and watered. Honest agents simply return the copper-wire proof of work they run anyway.
